details: The US military reportedly struck three Iranian tankers on September 5, 2026, following missile attacks on American warships. This comes amidst a broader escalation, with a former US defense secretary warning the conflict is likely to continue for another six months. Additionally, the US Energy Secretary indicated that a nuclear agreement with Iran might not be reached. The ongoing geopolitical instability and sanctions have severely impacted Iran's economy, causing its currency, the rial, to fall to a new all-time low of over 2 million rials to the US dollar by late August, representing a depreciation of more than 50% in a year.
title: US-Iran Tensions Escalate with Tanker Strikes; Iran's Currency Hits Record Low
